summary: Master retail category management and merchandising analytics with practical tools, dashboards, and assortment methods. Enroll in this 5-day course.
lede: Retail category analysis uses sales, inventory and shopper data to guide assortment, pricing, shelf-space and promotion decisions. For category managers, buyers, planners and merchandising analysts, this course covers diagnosing performance, forecasting demand, managing stock with Open-to-Buy and weeks-of-supply measures, assessing planograms and building dashboards for category reviews.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage category performance, assortment decisions, merchandising execution, and retail reporting across stores, buying, planning, and analytics functions.
prerequisites: To complete this course effectively, you need a laptop, Microsoft Excel, and the ability to work with retail sales and inventory data. No coding is required, and any digital dashboard work will remain at operational application level using provided templates or guided datasets.
